user.title: Ergon Energy outages
user.description: Choose the spot to watch, usually your home. Any Ergon outage area that touches the circle is reported. Drag the circle edge to set the radius; a few hundred metres is recommended.

data_description.name: Used in entity names, e.g. Home gives binary_sensor.ergon_outages_home_outage_now.
data_description.scan_interval: Ergon refreshes its outage map roughly every 15 minutes.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Ergon outage service. Check your internet connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This location is already being monitored.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Ergon outage service. Check your internet connection and try again.

resend_alerts.name: Resend alerts
resend_alerts.description: Re-checks Ergon and sends a fresh alert for every outage (current and upcoming) at the chosen location, or at every location. Outages shared by several locations arrive as one combined alert.

config_entry_id.name: Location
config_entry_id.description: Only this location. Leave empty for every location.

unknown_location.message: That Ergon outage location isn't loaded.
